<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--onesimus">Onesimus extension</span>

All versions of one file of a client (OVFS).

## Synopsis

```text
.ovfs_versions client=<client> path=<path> [name=<name>] [copies] [json]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Onesimus extension: lists all backed up versions of a file or directory of a client, newest first. Only versions stored on a volume from backup and archive jobs count; copies adds copy jobs. Versions from jobs the console may not see are left out. path= is the directory, name= the file; without name= the versions of the directory itself are listed.

Each line has ten tab separated columns: JobId, level, job type, start time, size, modification time, FileIndex, volumes, InChanger and MD5. json prints the result as one JSON line. Unlike .bvfs\_versions no PathIds are needed.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  | required | Client name. |
| `path=` | string |  |  | required | Directory. |
| `name=` | string |  |  |  | File name ('' = the directory). |
| `copies` | keyword |  |  |  | Include copy jobs. |
| `json` | keyword |  |  |  | Print the JSON object as text. |

## Examples

All versions of /etc/hosts:

```text
.ovfs_versions client=bareos-fd path=/etc/ name=hosts
```

Including copy jobs, as JSON:

```text
.ovfs_versions client=bareos-fd path=/etc/ name=fstab copies json
```
